text.tspan: Manual / fused BatchNorm arithmetic | Operators & tensor flow
static module / explicit profile / read bottom to top
Bottom-to-top; independent outputs are parallel, never an implicit tensor chain
Colors denote roles; Parameter / buffer / ordinary state are recorded separately in IR
Fixed source symbols + explicit profile; library operators are call boundaries
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.

g.aria-label: 节点 manual_fused_bn.x Feature tensor x
节点 manual_fused_bn.gain Provided gain / bias

节点 manual_fused_bn.cast x.float()
节点 manual_fused_bn.moments m=E[x]; m2=E[x^2]
节点 manual_fused_bn.variance var=m2-m^2; cast back
